settings.title: What is it?
settings.content: Small Sips. Big Changes. Meet the loose-blend version of Laushe Skinny Sips — made for those who love their daily kehwa without the hassle of tea bags. A carefully blended herbal infusion made with natural botanicals, Skinny Sips is an easy addition to your everyday wellness routine. No tea bag needed. No complicated preparation. Just scoop, steep, strain and sip.

settings.title: Who's it for
settings.content: Perfect for anyone who prefers traditional, loose-leaf brewing over tea bags — an easy way to add a warm herbal drink to your everyday wellness routine.

settings.title: Don't Want Tea Bags?
settings.content: No problem — Skinny Sips is now available as a loose herbal blend. Instead of opening a tea bag, simply: 1 teaspoon, hot water, 2 minutes, strain, enjoy. Perfect for people who prefer a more traditional way of preparing their kehwa.

settings.title: Storage
settings.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep the pouch tightly sealed after every use to preserve freshness.

settings.title: Important Note
settings.content: Skinny Sips is a herbal beverage intended to complement a balanced lifestyle. It is not a substitute for a balanced diet or medical treatment. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication, or have an existing medical condition, consult your healthcare professional before use.

settings.heading: Your Kehwa in 3 Simple Steps
settings.step1_text: Scoop — Take 1 teaspoon of Skinny Sips.
settings.step2_text: Steep — Add it to a cup of hot water and let it steep for 2 minutes.
settings.step3_text: Strain & Sip — Strain the herbs and enjoy your freshly prepared Skinny Sips kehwa warm.
settings.step4_text: Pro tip: Add a little honey if you prefer a naturally sweeter taste.

settings.heading: Skinny Sips Loose Blend vs. Other Brands

settings.question: Can I use Skinny Sips Loose Blend without dieting?
settings.answer: Yes, it's designed to support your body naturally, even without strict dieting. However, combining it with a balanced diet and an active lifestyle can help you achieve faster and more noticeable results.

settings.question: How is the loose blend different from the sachet version?
settings.answer: Both use the same herbal recipe. The loose blend lets you control the strength of each cup and brew fresh leaves directly, while sachets offer pre-measured convenience.

settings.question: How should I store the loose blend?
settings.answer: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep the pouch tightly sealed after every use to preserve freshness.

settings.question: Is it safe for daily use?
settings.answer: Yes, it's made with natural herbal ingredients and is safe for regular use when taken as directed. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication, or have an existing medical condition, consult your healthcare professional before use.

settings.question: What results can I expect with regular use?
settings.answer: With consistent use, many users notice reduced bloating, better digestion, and gradual weight loss within a few weeks. Continued use supports long-term results and a healthier routine.
